description: Take one of the developer's Caps live. Nothing is reviewed before launch and nobody approves it: when the three code-checked items pass (signature, end-to-end, price book), this publishes the Cap immediately and agents can call it — and be charged — from then on. Run test_cap first (it records signature + end-to-end; the price book is recorded when it saves). Qumge spot-checks docs and support afterwards and can suspend the Cap. Needs the developer's Qumge key. (Older clients may still call this tool as submit_app_review.)

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: submit_cap
